top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 is a complete, independently confirmed discovery chain with mature outcome-trial evidence. A discovery-anchored prize fits Physiology or Medicine best: Holst on native hormone physiology, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and the gut-pancreas axis, and Mojsov on identification and synthesis of the active GLP-1(7-36) form, the step that made all later pharmacology possible. P002 is a close second because Knudsen's long-acting analogues are a real contribution, but they are downstream engineering and the citation can acknowledge the therapeutic consequence. Mojsov's contested early-1980s priority cannot be verified from the supplied record, and that is the main weakness of P001. Any award is preferable to no award.
